mentions.name: Places
mentions.description: A web app for creating sharable, real-time synced maps, described as "Google Docs for maps." Its import feature lets users paste a link to a video or article, automatically pulls out places, and enriches them with images and a description. Users can also write their own notes, vote with friends on places to go, and apply colors to maps.
